name: io.echelongraph/echelongraph-mcp
title: EchelonGraph CVE & Exposure
description: CVE, KEV, EPSS, SBOM and advisory lookups; per-CVE exposure from Shodan data (© Shodan). Keyless.

environmentVariables.name: ECHELONGRAPH_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL (self-host or proxy).

environmentVariables.name: ECHELONGRAPH_API_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. A slower answer is reported as a failed lookup, not as empty data.
